claims.text: The surge-tank cap valve on the HMMWV (M998-series) relieves pressure at approximately 15 psi.
The cooling-system PMCS warning requires allowing the engine to cool to ambient temperature before removing the surge-tank cap after vehicle operation.
Allowing the engine to cool before surge-tank cap removal is intended to prevent burns from hot coolant or steam.
The cap-removal precaution is standard for safety during maintenance operations.
Specific references from TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1 (1996, including Change 2 dated 2004) were not provided in the REFERENCE.
The answer is based on standard maintenance practices and known HMMWV cooling-system procedures documented in official military maintenance manuals.
